videoTitle: You're Not Being Bitter—You're Being Charged More for Less Space
videoDescription: Equal per-person splits on group trips sound fair until you realize couples are sharing a bedroom and you're not. There's a better way to split costs that actually reflects what everyone's getting. Learn the method at mindtivate.com
script: Splitting the Airbnb equally per person sounds fair—until you realize you're paying the same as your coupled friends who are sharing a bedroom while you're solo. The fix isn't about paying less as a single person. It's actually about charging per bedroom, not per head, which means you'd pay more than any individual person, but here's why that's the fair model...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
